title_en: Dandong Yiyang Investment Co., Ltd. v. Dandong Intermediate People's Court of Liaoning Province — compensation for erroneous execution
ruling_gist_en: In cases where the people's court has indeed committed erroneous enforcement actions that have caused damage, and the judgment debtor has no ability to satisfy the judgment and will never have such ability, state compensation may be granted even if the enforcement proceedings have not yet concluded.
keywords_en: state compensation; compensation for erroneous enforcement; retrial; Supreme People's Court; Liaoning Province; legal person; state organ; State Compensation Law; whether state compensation can be applied for before conclusion of enforcement proceedings; determination of erroneous enforcement actions; whether termination of current enforcement proceedings equals conclusion of enforcement; reversal of judgment; erroneous enforcement; lifting of seizure; land auction; inability to recover creditor's rights; clarification of conditions for applying for state compensation before conclusion of enforcement proceedings; contract dispute
full_text_en:
Dandong Yiyang Investment Co., Ltd. v. Liaoning Province Dandong City

Intermediate People's Court — compensation for erroneous enforcement

[Ruling Summary]

In cases where a people's court has indeed committed erroneous enforcement actions that have indeed caused damage, and the judgment debtor is completely insolvent and has no possibility of becoming solvent, state compensation may be granted even if the enforcement proceedings have not yet been concluded.

Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court

State Compensation Decision

(2018) Zui Gao Fa Wei Pei Ti No. 3

Appellant (compensation claimant): Dandong Yiyang Investment Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 21-25 Hongqiao Community, Yuanbao District, Dandong City, Liaoning Province.

Legal representative: Wang Jicheng, Executive Director of the company.

Agent ad litem: Wang Jun, lawyer of Liaoning Fanxiang Law Firm.

Respondent (compensation obligor): Liaoning Province Dandong City Intermediate People's Court. Domicile: No. 30 Binjiang Middle Road, Zhenxing District, Dandong City, Liaoning Province.

Legal representative: Wang Yuyan, President of the court.

Agent ad litem: Jiang Jinjing, staff member of the court.

Agent ad litem: Wang Zuowei, staff member of the court.

The appellant, Dandong Yiyang Investment Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yiyang Company), dissatisfied with the decision of the Compensation Committee of the Liaoning Province Higher People's Court (hereinafter referred to as Liaoning High Court) (2015) Liao Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 29 regarding its application for compensation for erroneous enforcement by Liaoning Province Dandong City Intermediate People's Court (hereinafter referred to as Dandong Intermediate Court), filed an appeal with the Compensation Committee of this Court. The Compensation Committee of this Court, by a decision dated March 22, 2018, (2017) Zui Gao Fa Wei Pei Jian No. 236, decided that this case would be directly heard by the Compensation Committee of this Court. The Compensation Committee of this Court formed a collegial panel composed of Vice President Tao Kaiyuan as presiding judge, and trial judges Zhu Erjun, Huang Jinlong, Gao Ke, and Liang Qing to hear this case. Assistant judge Xu Chao assisted in handling the case, and clerk Han Xue served as recorder. On June 29, 2018, the collegial panel conducted a public cross-examination of this case. This case is now concluded.

On July 16, 2015, Yiyang Company filed a compensation application with the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court, stating: During the enforcement of the case of Yiyang Company v. Dandong Tire Factory regarding a dispute over a creditor's rights assignment contract, Dandong Intermediate Court, without the consent of Yiyang Company, arbitrarily lifted the sealing-up of the involved land, resulting in the sealed-up land being auctioned off, causing Yiyang Company's loan of more than RMB 10 million to be unrecoverable, resulting in huge losses. Therefore, the request was: to lawfully confirm that Dandong Intermediate Court's act of arbitrarily lifting the sealing-up was illegal, and to decide that Dandong Intermediate Court should compensate Yiyang Company for the principal loss of RMB 10,429,022.76, interest of RMB 9,826,676.78 (calculated to September 4, 2014), case acceptance fee of RMB 84,374, and preservation fee of RMB 5,000. Dandong Intermediate Court did not respond.

After hearing the case, the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court issued a decision on April 27, 2016, (2015) Liao Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 29, finding the facts as follows: In the case of Yiyang Company v. Dandong Tire Factory regarding a dispute over a creditor's rights assignment contract, Dandong Intermediate Court, upon Yiyang Company's application for property preservation, issued a civil ruling on May 23, 2007, (2007) Dan Min San Chu Zi No. 32-1: freeze Dandong Tire Factory's bank deposits of RMB 10.5 million or seal up property of corresponding value. The next day, Dandong Intermediate Court issued a notice of assistance in execution to Dandong Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources, requesting assistance in: sealing up six parcels of land belonging to Dandong Tire Factory at No. 134 Zhenqi Street, Zhenxing District, Dandong City, namely: Land Certificate No. 061412002, area 15,168.8 m²; Certificate No. 061412003, area 1,817.5 m²; Certificate No. 061412004, area 551.9 m²; Certificate No. 061412005, area 221.5 m²; Certificate No. 061205002, area 182.4 m²; Certificate No. 061205004, area 333.5 m². On June 29, 2007, Dandong Intermediate Court issued a civil judgment (2007) Dan Min San Chu Zi No. 32, ordering Dandong Tire Factory to repay Yiyang Company's debt of RMB 4.22 million and interest of RMB 6,209,022.76 (interest calculated to December 20, 2006; interest from December 21, 2006 to the date of full payment of the said debt shall be calculated according to the loan contract). The case acceptance fee of RMB 84,374 and property preservation fee of RMB 5,000 shall be borne by Dandong Tire Factory. After the judgment became legally effective, Yiyang Company applied to Dandong Intermediate Court for compulsory enforcement. During the enforcement process, Dandong Intermediate Court issued civil rulings on January 30, 2008, (2007) Dan Li Xing Zi No. 53-1 and 53-2: lift the sealing-up of the land parcels belonging to Dandong Tire Factory at No. 134 Zhenqi Street, Zhenxing District, Dandong City, with Land Certificate No. 061412002, area 15,168.8 m²; Certificate No. 061412003, area 1,817.5 m²; and Certificate No. 061412005, area 221.5 m². The above land was then listed for sale by Dandong Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources to Taipingwan Power Plant. Starting from 2009, Yiyang Company repeatedly submitted state compensation applications to Dandong Intermediate Court. Dandong Intermediate Court accepted the case on August 13, 2013, but never made a decision. Yiyang Company then applied to the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court for a compensation decision.

The Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court held: Article 8 of the "Interpretation (I) of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China" provides: "A compensation claimant who believes that a people's court has the circumstances specified in Article 38 of the amended State Compensation Law shall file a compensation claim after the conclusion of the civil or administrative litigation proceedings or enforcement proceedings..." In the case where Yiyang Company applied to Dandong Intermediate Court for compulsory enforcement of the civil judgment (2007) Dan Min San Chu Zi No. 32, the enforcement proceedings had not yet been concluded. Yiyang Company, believing that the erroneous enforcement by Dandong Intermediate Court caused it damage, should file a compensation claim after the conclusion of the enforcement proceedings. On April 27, 2016, the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court, in accordance with Article 3(1) of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Procedures for the Compensation Committee of People's Courts to Hear State Compensation Cases," decided: Reject the state compensation application of the compensation claimant Dandong Yiyang Investment Co., Ltd.

Yiyang Company, dissatisfied, filed an appeal with the Compensation Committee of this Court, requesting: to lawfully revoke the decision (2015) Liao Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 29, and order the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court to make a decision granting compensation in this case. Main reasons: (1) The decision (2015) Liao Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 29 erred in finding facts and applying law. First, Dandong Intermediate Court had already ruled on March 1, 2016, to conclude the current enforcement proceedings of the civil judgment (2007) Dan Min San Chu Zi No. 32 by final disposition of this enforcement procedure (zhong jie ben ci zhi xing cheng xu), but Liaoning High Court, after receiving this ruling, did not use it as a basis for finding facts and still considered the enforcement proceedings not concluded, thus applying the law incorrectly. Second, Chapter 22 of the "Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China" only provides for suspension and termination of enforcement, not for "conclusion of current enforcement proceedings" (zhong jie ben ci zhi xing cheng xu). Article 519 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China" provides for conclusion of current enforcement proceedings, but this can only be understood as a form of termination of enforcement under the Civil Procedure Law, not as a suspension of enforcement, nor as an independent procedure separate from termination of enforcement, otherwise it would conflict with the Civil Procedure Law. Moreover, according to Article 519(2) of that Interpretation, if Yiyang Company no longer applies for enforcement, it would also be impossible to enforce again after the conclusion of current enforcement proceedings. Therefore, conclusion of current enforcement proceedings is precisely termination of enforcement. (2) The decision (2015) Liao Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 29 confuses the two different concepts of "illegally lifting a sealing-up" and "erroneous enforcement" and made an erroneous decision, harming the lawful rights and interests of Yiyang Company. The decision held that "Yiyang Company, believing that the erroneous enforcement by Dandong Intermediate Court caused it damage, should file a compensation claim after the conclusion of the enforcement proceedings." However, Yiyang Company's state compensation claim was based on the fact that Dandong Intermediate Court illegally lifted the sealing-up of the involved land, ultimately causing Yiyang Company's huge creditor's rights to become uncollectible. In this process, Dandong Intermediate Court's act of lifting the sealing-up was not an erroneous enforcement act in the enforcement case applied for by Yiyang Company, but a separate tortious act of official duty carried out by Dandong Intermediate Court outside the case. Therefore, the rule "file a compensation claim after the conclusion of enforcement proceedings" naturally does not apply to the handling of this act. (3) The decision (2015) Liao Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 29 echoes Dandong Intermediate Court's conduct, using loopholes in judicial interpretation to harm Yiyang Company's lawful rights and interests, resulting in Yiyang Company being forever excluded from the compensation procedure. According to the view of the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court, based on Article 8 of the "Interpretation (I) of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China," which provides that a compensation claimant who believes that a people's court has the circumstances specified in Article 38 of the amended State Compensation Law shall file a compensation claim after the conclusion of civil or administrative litigation proceedings or enforcement proceedings, this case seems to require waiting until the enforcement proceedings of Dandong Intermediate Court are concluded and it is confirmed that the judgment debtor Dandong Tire Factory has no other property available for enforcement before filing a state compensation application. But in reality, after Dandong Intermediate Court arbitrarily lifted the sealing-up of the land, the relevant land was immediately sold at a price of RMB 46 million, and all proceeds were used by Dandong Tire Factory to pay off debts to other creditors, while Yiyang Company, as the lawful holder of the sealing-up right, received nothing. After the land was sold, the judgment debtor Dandong Tire Factory no longer had any effective assets to pay off other debts. The only reason it was not dissolved or declared bankrupt was to continue shouldering debts in the name of Dandong Tire Factory. This is also why Dandong Intermediate Court did not take any subsequent enforcement measures against Dandong Tire Factory for a long time. Since there was no property available for enforcement, a ruling of termination of enforcement should have been issued. But if a termination of enforcement ruling were issued, Yiyang Company would inevitably file a state compensation application based on it, and would inevitably win. Dandong Intermediate Court was well aware of this. To appease Yiyang Company, Dandong Intermediate Court, during the hearing of this case by the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court, served Yiyang Company with a ruling of "conclusion of current enforcement proceedings," which more clearly demonstrates Dandong Intermediate Court's subjective intent to evade legal liability. The Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court was also fully aware of the above legal provisions and specific circumstances, but still dismissed Yiyang Company's compensation application on the ground that the enforcement proceedings were not concluded, effectively excluding Yiyang Company from normal channels of rights protection.

In response to Yiyang Company's appeal, Dandong Intermediate Court responded: (1) Yiyang Company's compensation application did not meet the conditions for filing. The enforcement case involved had not yet been concluded, so Yiyang Company's state compensation application did not comply with Article 8 of the "Interpretation (I) of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China." The Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court correctly decided to dismiss Yiyang Company's compensation application after filing, in accordance with Article 3 of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Procedures for the Compensation Committee of People's Courts to Hear State Compensation Cases." (2) Dandong Intermediate Court's lifting of the sealing-up was consistent with the policy spirit of the Supreme People's Court at that time. According to the spirit of a telephone notice from the Supreme People's Court at that time, litigation cases for purchasing creditor's rights should not be accepted, those already accepted should be suspended, and enforcement measures should not be taken in cases that had entered enforcement proceedings. At that time, the litigation case between Yiyang Company and Dandong Tire Factory had entered the enforcement stage, and Dandong Intermediate Court had already sealed up the involved land. In accordance with the spirit of the telephone notice, Dandong Intermediate Court then lifted the sealing-up of the involved land. (3) Dandong Tire Factory still had property available for enforcement. In the case of Dandong Tire Factory Trade Union applying for enforcement against Dandong Tire Factory, Dandong Intermediate Court successively sealed up the factory's land use rights under certificates Danguo Yong (93) Zi No. 063204006 and 061213015, a 700 m² warehouse and land use rights at No. 52 Zhenqi Street, Zhenxing District, Dandong City, and other property. Dandong Tire Factory agreed to squeeze out RMB 1 million from the process of resolving debts owed to employees to repay Yiyang Company. (4) The purpose of Dandong Intermediate Court's lifting of the sealing-up of the involved land was to properly resettle employees and maintain social stability. As of March 7, 2007, Dandong Tire Factory still had 30 retired veteran cadres, 1,014 retired employees, 2,426 employees participating in the parallel track, 76 active registered employees, and 115 other persons, including 11 transfers, 37 surviving dependents, and 67 deceased, totaling 3,661 indebted persons in the factory. The enterprise owed these 3,661 persons living expenses, heating fees, medical expenses, and other debts totaling RMB 46 million, and a large number of employees had petitioned. To maintain social stability and effectively resolve the issue of employee resettlement, pursuant to the requirements of the mayor's office meeting on November 19, 2007, and in accordance with the spirit of the telephone notice of the Supreme People's Court, Dandong Intermediate Court lifted the sealing-up of the involved land on January 31, 2008, enabling the smooth listing and sale of the involved land, initially alleviating the employees' difficulties and preventing large-scale petitioning incidents. In summary, the request was to dismiss Yiyang Company's appeal.

The Compensation Committee of this Court confirms the facts found by the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court. Additionally found: (1) On November 7, 1997, the Bank of Communications Dandong Branch and Dandong Tire Factory signed a loan contract, agreeing that the latter would borrow RMB 4.22 million from the former at a monthly interest rate of 7.92‰. On June 7, 2004, this creditor's right was transferred to the Shenyang Office of China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd., and later changed hands and was purchased by Yiyang Company. (2) On November 19, 2007, the 51st Mayor's Office Meeting of Dandong Municipal People's Government resolved, "Regarding matters concerning the realization of assets of Dandong Tire Factory to resettle employees and repay debts," "instruct the Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, together with the Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources, the Municipal Finance Bureau, and other relevant departments, to formulate a feasible implementation plan for the listing of the land parcel at the location of Dandong Tire Factory in accordance with the principles determined at the meeting, to ensure the smooth transfer of the land parcel." On the 21st of the same month, Dandong Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources published an announcement in the "Dandong Daily" regarding the listing and transfer of the land of the main plant of Dandong Tire Factory. On December 28 of the same year, Dandong Property Rights Trading Center published an announcement regarding the listing and transfer of the boiler house and kindergarten land of Dandong Tire Factory. The land transfer proceeds of RMB 46.8 million were all used by Dandong Tire Factory to repay internal debts to employees, employee collective funds, medical expenses, ordinary debts, etc., and none was paid to Yiyang Company. (3) During the hearing by the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High Court, Dandong Intermediate Court, in response to Yiyang Company's enforcement application, issued an enforcement ruling on March 1, 2016, (2016) Liao 06 Zhi No. 15, finding that Dandong Tire Factory currently had no other property available for enforcement, and ruled: The enforcement proceedings of the civil judgment (2007) Dan Min San Chu Zi No. 32 are concluded for the time being (zhong jie ben ci zhi xing cheng xu). Both Yiyang Company and Dandong Intermediate Court explicitly stated no objection to the above facts during cross-examination.

The Compensation Committee of this Court holds: The basic facts of this case are clear, the evidence is true and sufficient, and there is no substantive dispute between the parties. The focus of the dispute between the parties mainly lies in three issues of law application: First, is the act of Dandong Intermediate Court in lifting the sealing-up in nature a preservation act or an enforcement act? Second, does Dandong Intermediate Court's act of lifting the sealing-up constitute erroneous enforcement, and what is the specific legal basis? Third, should Dandong Intermediate Court bear state compensation liability?

Regarding the first focus issue. Yiyang Company argued that Dandong Intermediate Court's act of lifting the sealing-up was not an enforcement act of that court, but an illegal preservation act independently carried out by that court outside the case. In response, Dandong Intermediate Court argued that it was an enforcement act. The Compensation Committee of this Court holds: During the trial of the case of Yiyang Company v. Dandong Tire Factory regarding a dispute over a creditor's rights assignment contract, Dandong Intermediate Court lawfully adopted property preservation measures and sealed up the relevant land of Dandong Tire Factory. After the civil judgment became effective and entered the enforcement procedure, according to Article 4 of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Sealing-up, Attachment, and Freezing of Property in Civil Enforcement by People's Courts," the preservation sealing-up measures in litigation have automatically converted into sealing-up measures in enforcement. Therefore, Dandong Intermediate Court's act of lifting the sealing-up is an enforcement act.

Regarding the second focus issue. Yiyang Company claimed that Dandong Intermediate Court's act of lifting the sealing-up was without Yiyang Company's consent and ultimately caused Yiyang Company's huge creditor's rights to become uncollectible, constituting illegality. Dandong Intermediate Court argued that its act of lifting the sealing-up was carried out at the request of the municipal government and was consistent with the relevant policy spirit of the Supreme People's Court. In this regard, the Compensation Committee of this Court holds: Dandong Intermediate Court, in order to cooperate with government departments in transferring the involved land, could lift the sealing-up of the involved land, but it must effectively control the land transfer proceeds and distribute those proceeds in accordance with the statutory order of priority to ensure the enforcement of the effective judgment. However, after implementing the act of lifting the sealing-up, Dandong Intermediate Court did not effectively control the land transfer proceeds and distribute them in accordance with the law, resulting in Yiyang Company's creditor's rights not receiving any satisfaction. This act does not conform to the judicial policy spirit of the Supreme People's Court on lawfully and properly handling financial non-performing asset cases, infringes on the lawful rights and interests of Yiyang Company, and constitutes erroneous enforcement.

As for the specific legal basis for erroneous enforcement, because Dandong Intermediate Court's act of lifting the sealing-up occurred in 2008, the judicial interpretation effective at that time should apply, namely, the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Judicial Compensation in Civil and Administrative Litigation" issued by the Supreme People's Court in 2000. Since Dandong Intermediate Court's act occurred in the enforcement stage after the civil judgment became effective, it is an erroneous act of arbitrarily lifting the sealing-up resulting in the failure to enforce the civil judgment, therefore it should fall under the circumstance of other erroneous enforcement acts contrary to legal provisions specified in Article 4(7) of that Interpretation.

Regarding the third focal issue. Yiyang Company contends that the judgment debtor, Dandong Tire Factory, does not merely have no property available for execution temporarily, but has completely lost its capacity to repay. The execution procedure should not remain in a "case closure without full satisfaction" status for a long time; rather, it should be substantively concluded. Therefore, this case should be accepted and a decision should be made that Dandong Intermediate People's Court compensate Yiyang Company for the principal of the unfulfilled claim, interest, and related litigation costs. Dandong Intermediate People's Court argues that the execution procedure in question has not yet been concluded, the judgment debtor Dandong Tire Factory still has property available for execution, and Yiyang Company's application does not meet the acceptance conditions for state compensation. In this regard, the Compensation Committee of this Court holds that the conclusion of the execution procedure is not an absolute standard for initiating the state compensation procedure. Generally, only after the execution procedure is concluded can the amount of losses caused to the parties by erroneous execution actions be determined, can the coexistence and overlap of execution and compensation procedures be avoided, and can a final review and handling of the compensation case be conducted after exhausting other remedies. However, this understanding should not be absolutized or formalized; it should be understood in a substantive sense. Where the people's court's execution actions have shown no progress for a long time and are impossible to make progress, the judgment debtor has actually completely lost its capacity to repay, and the applying execution creditor has suffered irreparable losses due to the erroneous execution actions, the applying execution creditor should be allowed to file a state compensation application. Otherwise, as long as a court that has committed erroneous execution actions does not render a conclusion of the execution procedure, the state compensation procedure cannot be initiated. Such an understanding runs counter to the original intent of the State Compensation Law and relevant judicial interpretations. In this case, the execution actions of Dandong Intermediate People's Court have shown no progress for eleven years, and its erroneous execution actions have been proven to have caused Yiyang Company actual losses that cannot be recovered through other channels. Therefore, it should bear state compensation liability in accordance with the law. The Compensation Committee of Liaoning High People's Court's decision to dismiss Yiyang Company's compensation application on the grounds that the execution procedure has not yet been concluded constitutes an error in the application of law and should be corrected.

As to the specific damages and amount of compensation, after the Compensation Committee of this Court organized consultations between the applicant and the respondent, both parties voluntarily reached the following agreement regarding the execution of Civil Judgment No. 32 (2007) Dan Min San Chu Zi No. 32 of Dandong Intermediate People's Court: (1) Dandong Intermediate People's Court shall pay Yiyang Company state compensation of RMB 3,000,000 within five days after this Decision becomes effective; (2) Yiyang Company voluntarily waives any other state compensation claims; (3) Yiyang Company voluntarily waives the execution of the said civil judgment, and Dandong Intermediate People's Court shall render a ruling to conclude the execution procedure in that civil case.

In summary, in this case, the facts of Dandong Intermediate People's Court's erroneous execution are clear, and the evidence is truthful and sufficient. The Compensation Committee of Liaoning High People's Court's decision to dismiss Yiyang Company's application was erroneous and should be corrected. The compensation agreement reached between Yiyang Company and Dandong Intermediate People's Court represents the true intentions of both parties, does not violate legal provisions, and should be confirmed. Pursuant to Article 30, paragraphs 1 and 2 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, and Articles 11(4), 18, and 21(3) of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning State Compensation Supervision Procedures, the Compensation Committee of this Court decides as follows:

1. The Decision No. 29 (2015) Liao Fa Wei Pei Zi of the Compensation Committee of Liaoning High People's Court is hereby revoked;

2. Dandong Intermediate People's Court of Liaoning Province shall pay Dandong Yiyang Investment Co., Ltd. state compensation of RMB 3,000,000 within five days after this Decision becomes effective;

3. Dandong Yiyang Investment Co., Ltd. is permitted to waive any other state compensation claims.

This Decision is a legally effective decision.

June 29, 2018
